title: Small Thorium Vein
wikitext:
'''Small Thorium Veins''' can be found primarily in zones that are in the 50–60 level range.
[[File:Small Thorium Vein.png|thumb|Small Thorium Vein]]

== Contents ==
With [[Mining]] (245), these veins can be looted for:

* [https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Thorium_Ore Thorium Ore]
* [https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Dense_Stone Dense Stone] (uncommon)
* [https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Azerothian_Diamond Azerothian Diamond] (very rare)
* [https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Black_Vitriol Black Vitriol] (very rare)
* [https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Blue_Sapphire Blue Sapphire] (very rare)
* [https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Huge_Emerald Huge Emerald] (very rare)
* [https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Large_Opal Large Opal] (very rare)
* [https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Star_Ruby Star Ruby] (very rare)
